Set in an exclusive seaside enclave in the heart of central Kiama, this charming two-bedroom “harbour apartment” offers breathtaking views across the iconic Kiama Harbour and an enviable coastal lifestyle. Positioned in a boutique complex of only four, this sunny, low-maintenance apartment has been freshly painted with brand-new flooring throughout, creating a bright and refreshed living environment. The lounge room is also equipped with air conditioning, providing year-round comfort. Boasting an unbeatable location, you can leave the car at home and enjoy everything Kiama has to offer right at your doorstep. Simply throw a towel over your shoulder and stroll to the harbour precinct, boutique shops, cafés, bars, restaurants, ocean pools and the iconic Bombo Beach. Highlighting:2 bedrooms, main with built inFreshly paintedNew flooringAir conditioning in lounge roomStunning views of Kiama.
